decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel remains core to trusted communication and is a low-cost option with still-valuable strategic upside.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture underpins other products and offers high option value at low marginal keeping cost.
The QR-code hardware token has higher ongoing costs, uncertain demand as software alternatives grow, and weaker fit with the firm's mobile software direction.
The payment network security compliance suite aligns with growing transaction security needs and warrants keeping while regulatory uncertainty resolves.
